overall.summary: OrthoplexEMR publishes a clear, provider-run C-CDA export workflow for single-patient and population use, but the documented output is a summary-style projection with limited structural detail and likely gaps for full designated-record-set completeness.

notableFacts: The primary EHI documentation is a single static HTML artifact in downloads/, not a multi-document technical package.
Both single-patient and patient-population exports are documented as provider-run UI workflows under History -> CCDA and Utilities -> CCDA.
Population export supports recurring schedules (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) and requires access to an internal shared server via MKO network or VPN.
The documented C-CDA content inventory lists 18 sections, including medications, problems, allergies, vitals, procedures, results, and care-plan-related sections.
Immunizations are explicitly documented as empty for this practice context ("Immunizations not provided at clinics").
